en: Beyond this door the Elite Four are waiting. Only a Trainer with all eight of Johto's Gym Badges goes through.
Let me see... Eight Badges, every one of them Johto's. You may go in.
Once you start, you face all four and then the Champion. There is no coming back out until it is over.
Come back when you have all eight. The Elite Four won't see anyone with fewer.
Rest your Pokémon well. Nobody will heal them for you between the rooms.
